secrets.name: TELEGRAM_API_ID
secrets.description: Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools section)

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_API_HASH
secrets.description: Telegram API hash from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools section)

secrets.name: STREAM_TOKEN
secrets.description: Arbitrary secret token used to authenticate requests to the streaming API. Set any random string.

secrets.name: SESSION_STRING
secrets.description: GramJS StringSession from running `npm run login` interactively. Required unless TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is provided.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bot token from @BotFather on Telegram. Alternative to SESSION_STRING for client auth.
